# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Dependency update
- [ ] Security hardening

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change scoped to Elderheim's existing architecture.
- [ ] I updated docs or release notes when behavior changed.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I ran `scripts/checks.sh`.
- [ ] I checked dependency/license impact when adding or updating crates.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, tokens, local manuals, or generated artifacts.

## Security Notes

Describe any security-sensitive impact. Mention parsing, relocation math,
executable writing, runtime fragments, CLI file paths, dependencies, or CI
workflow changes if they are touched.

## Scheduled Follow-Up Releases

List explicit follow-up release versions for any accepted non-blocking work.
Committed scope must not be left as an unnamed future task.
